DATA CONTRACT

Product + approved fitment

Stable product ID, size, minimum load/speed, fitment version. Sample fitment is illustrative.

FRESHNESS CONTRACT

Inventory + location

Quantity, observation time, source event, delivery estimate. Older and duplicate updates cannot overwrite newer stock.

RESPONSE CONTRACT

Recommendation + evidence

Compatible options, factor contributions, scope, filter revision, request ID, versions, and measured timing.

The choices behind the implementation.

ADR 01

SQL establishes eligibility.

Compatibility, stock and freshness are deterministic constraints. AI can select explanation emphasis; application code renders product facts.

Decision record ↓
ADR 02

Two adapters, one contract.

SQLite keeps the demonstration reproducible. Snowflake uses parameterized warehouse queries and a separately validated connection.

Decision record ↓
ADR 03

Stock has a clock.

Inventory is independently timestamped and loaded idempotently. A conversation never converts an old observation into fresh availability.

Decision record ↓
ADR 04

Ranking exposes its tradeoffs.

Fixed feature normalization, explicit weights, stable tie-breaking, and separate above-budget upgrade suggestions.
